subject: Temporary surcharge & amendment request — usage spike
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@atlasretail.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Procurement <procurement@atlasretail.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Sudden spike — temporary surcharge & amendment request

Diego,

Quick note — over the last 48 hours we've had a big uptick in inference volume for the campaign behind Project Beacon. Usage spiked roughly 4x and we're flagged for immediate throttling on our side unless we move to a different rate tier. Procurement asked if Redwood can authorize a temporary surcharge rate for the increased usage while we reclassify committed capacity in our order form.

We're formally requesting: (1) a short-term surcharge (six weeks) on top of our current committed rate to avoid throttling; (2) a one-page amendment we can sign quickly (DocuSign preferred); (3) written confirmation that the surcharge does not change our data residency/SOC2 commitments.

I've attached a Usage_Report_June.xlsx that shows the daily spike and our forecasted ramp if marketing continues. Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated surcharge percentage? If you need procurement/legal on the call, loop them in.

Thanks,

Emily Stone
Head of Product — Atlas Retail
emily.stone@atlasretail.com
+1 415 555 0198

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sudden spike — temporary surcharge & amendment request

Emily — thanks for the heads-up and for the usage file. We can absolutely avoid throttling; the quickest path is a short-term fee addendum tied to actual overage consumption plus an explicit sunset date.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll coordinate a draft amendment and include a clear sunset/automatic-reversion clause so this doesn't change your long-term order form.
- I'll loop in Legal (Jonas) for redlines and Finance (Monica) for prorated billing language.
- Can you confirm whether Atlas wants the surcharge to be an absolute cents-per-token uplift or an X% uplift over the committed rate? Procurement usually prefers a % uplift.

Proposed call windows tomorrow (Mon): 9:30–10:30 PT or 1:00–2:00 PT. If procurement prefers, we can do just DocuSign.

I attached a short checklist we use for these emergency amendments — it speeds review.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0103

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 10:24:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sudden spike — temporary surcharge & amendment request

Diego / Emily,

I reviewed the request and sketched redlines. Key legal controls we want in the amendment:
1) Term: explicit start and end dates (e.g., commence on execution, expire 42 days later) with no automatic renewal.
2) Cap: surcharge must be capped at a fixed maximum uplift (we propose no more than 50% over committed per-token price in extraordinary spikes) — allows business flexibility while containing exposure.
3) Data / Compliance: a statement reaffirming that all existing data protection, logging, and SOC2 obligations remain in force.
4) Billing reconciliation: require a reconciliation within 30 days after the surcharge period ends and a mechanism to credit any overcollection.
5) Approval path: signature by both parties or DocuSign link; internal signatory block for Redwood Sales + Legal.

I've attached Amendment_Draft_v2.docx with these redlines inline. A couple of notes for Finance: we need the expected $ volume band to set whether this counts as "overage" vs. a temporary commitment increase — Monica, can you advise on accounting/proration?

Samir (external counsel) feel free to chime if Atlas wants different warranty language.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 13:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sudden spike — temporary surcharge & amendment request

Diego / team / Emily,

Finance perspective:
- We can accept a temporary surcharge with proration and a post-period reconciliation. Recommended mechanics: daily metered usage at standard committed rate + surcharge percentage applied only to volume above the committed baseline for the surcharge window.
- If Atlas prefers a simple uplift across all tokens, it speeds invoicing but may overcharge for committed baseline — procurement typically rejects that.
- For reporting, we'll produce a reconciliation invoice within 30 days and credit any amounts that exceed the agreed-on calculated surcharge.

Please confirm the committed baseline numbers (tokens/day or monthly committed units) and whether Atlas wants surcharge applied to only incremental volume. I linked the HubSpot record (https://hubspot.com/contacts/ATL-7890) for billing history.

Monica Patel
Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@atlasretail.com>, Atlas Procurement <procurement@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir@vendorlaw.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden spike — temporary surcharge & amendment request

Emily — consolidated reply and proposed next steps below, and attaching Amendment_Draft_v2.docx for signature via DocuSign.

Summary of agreement in principle:
- Surcharge model: percentage uplift applied only to incremental volume above Atlas' committed baseline (as Monica recommended).
- Cap: surcharge capped at 50% uplift over the committed per-token rate, per Jonas' redline.
- Term: 42 days from execution, with automatic end (no renewal).
- Reconciliation: Finance will produce a reconciliation invoice within 30 days after the term ends and credit any overcollection.
- Compliance: No change to data residency or SOC2 obligations.

Action items:
1) Emily/Procurement: confirm the committed baseline numbers (tokens/month) by EOD today so Monica can finalize the reconciliation formula.
2) Jonas/Legal + Laura: final quick pass on Amendment_Draft_v2.docx — I'll route via DocuSign (https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/ATL-4567) once signed off.
3) If agreed, we aim to execute by end of day tomorrow to avoid any throttling.

Emily — if procurement prefers a 1-click DocuSign with the pre-filled baseline numbers, tell me the baseline and I'll push the envelope.

Thanks everyone — I attached the amended doc and the usage report again.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
